description: The customer's EventBridge Scheduler entries - dated commitments that fire the agent, a lambda, or SNS. op: create | get | list | update | delete.

name.description: Required by every op but list. group='calendar': an owner-meaningful slug ('reporting'). group='timers': compose with modules/calendar/timers.py name(module, record_id, action) from a script — a hand-written name is invisible to the prefix lookup that cancels a record's timers. Unique within the group.

schedule_expression.description: cron(M H D M ? Y) | rate(N units) | at(YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). create: required. update: omit to keep.

timezone.description: IANA name, e.g. America/Los_Angeles; defaults to the business's clock. update: omit to keep.

target_type.description: create/update: agent_runtime (default; target_input becomes the agent's turn) | lambda | sns. update: omit to keep.

target_arn.description: create/update: only for lambda or sns; agent_runtime is wired automatically.

target_input.description: create/update: payload delivered on fire; for agent_runtime, the message the agent receives.

description.description: create/update: what this schedule does. update: omit to keep.

start_date.description: create: ISO-8601 UTC; a recurrence does not fire before it.

end_date.description: create: ISO-8601 UTC; a recurrence stops after it.

delete_after.description: create: remove the schedule after its last run (default true); false to keep it.

name_contains.description: list: substring match, walks the group; narrow with name_prefix.

next_token.description: list: token from the previous page.
